INSERT INTO mcp_servers (user_id, app_slug, server_name, account_id, enabled)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id, app_slug) DO UPDATE SET
                server_name = EXCLUDED.server_name,
                account_id = EXCLUDED.account_id,
                enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled,
                updated_at = NOW()
